[[Klaus]] is a depressed [[Kurzick]] who desired to become a [[Kurzick Juggernaut]]. He is one of the three volunteers who turn into Juggernauts during [[the Eternal Grove]] mission.

==Locations==
*[[Echovald Forest]]
**{{NPC location|Drazach Thicket}} (only during The Defenders of the Forest)

==Quests==
'''Quests involved in:'''
*Echovald Forest
**[[The Defenders of the Forest]]

==Dialogue==
:''"For years I've cowered behind my father's shadow, scared of everything...scared to disappoint him, scared to anger him, scared to fail. But that's all in the past. When I heard that volunteers were needed for some new juggernauts, everything suddenly became clear: the gods put me here to protect and serve my people! I have never been surer of anything in my entire life."''

==Notes==
*Becomes [[Elite Juggernaut Klaus]] following the [[Defenders of the Forest]] quest, as seen in the [[The Eternal Grove]] mission.
